answer: Make the attacker subsidise its own opposition. A walnut head is credited only while a named echo head stays alive, solvent and unbribed at settlement, funded by a neutral treasury that is neither claimant nor winner; the echo counters the walnut's claim from its own first-hand experience. A prism of graded shares routes credit to the echo, shrinking the walnut's slice. The scarce input per head is an unbribed opponent's survival, which cannot be bought or lent between heads, so every extra head must endow a rival that outvotes it. The farm funds its own defeat.
